quantitative_model: An exact controlled linear-mixture model. Each potential product under the declared cleavage contributes one molecule per occurrence per parent molecule. The assay records the SUM of molar amounts of every peptide assigned to a mass channel; it does not distinguish peptide sequences in that channel. Every predicted product in this finite reference library is represented in a listed channel. The quantities are independently response-corrected molar amounts, NOT raw intensities. Assume complete cleavage/recovery, no modification, no unlisted parents and nonnegative continuous parent amounts. There is no sparsity, equal-abundance, equal-sharing or minimum-norm prior.
question_scope: Infer sharp amount bounds and which individual library entries must have strictly positive amount in EVERY feasible mixture. A feasible optimizer alone is not evidence that its amounts are uniquely identified.

provenance.kind: Project-authored short benign reference-polypeptide and exact calibrated-mixture fixture for inference-method assessment; no natural protein, biological activity or real experimental yield is claimed.

method_basis.read: Introduction and methods discussion of shared-peptide abundance constraints and known detectability, not the biological application.
method_basis.adaptation: We stipulate exact already calibrated absolute molar channels, merge mass-indistinguishable sequences, and ask for sharp bounds rather than selecting one abundance fit. The sequences and numeric fixture are ours.
